$comment: Local notifications scheduled by JS (src/lib/notifications.ts): recurring payments and debts. Notifications posted by Swift live in native.json. amount is a formatted amount with its currency ("12.99 EUR"); date is a day, maybe with a time ("22 Sep at 11:17").

fallbackName.note: Used in a title when a recurring rule has neither a payee nor a category.

upcoming.note: Title of the reminder before a recurring payment; name is the payee or category.

notSeen.note: Title when a payment the rule was waiting for from the bank never arrived.

posted.note: Title when an automatic rule wrote its payment.

due.note: Title when a manual rule's payment is due and needs confirming.

recurring.lateAuto: No charge for this arrived since {date}, so {amount} was added from the rule.
recurring.lateManual: No charge for this arrived since {date}. Tap to post it or skip it.
recurring.dueToday: {amount} is due today. Tap to confirm.

missedFallback.note: Stands in for the payee in a list of missed payments when the rule has none.

recurring.neverArrived: {count, plural, =1 {A recurring payment never arrived} one {# recurring payment never arrived} other {# recurring payments never arrived}}

neverArrivedBody.message: Nothing was charged in time, so the rule was used instead: {list}
neverArrivedBody.note: list is payees with amounts, comma-separated.

recurring.postedMissed: {count, plural, =1 {Posted a missed recurring transaction} one {Posted # missed recurring transaction} other {Posted # missed recurring transactions}}

tomorrowTitle.note: Title of a debt reminder the day before it is due; person is who the debt is with.

todayTitle.note: Title of a debt reminder on the day.
